item.title: About
item.description:
I’m Wayne McKnight — network administrator, U.S. Navy veteran, and IT professional based in Columbus, Texas.

I’ve spent 25+ years working in IT across government, law enforcement, healthcare, and education. I currently manage network infrastructure for Brenham ISD and previously served as IT Coordinator for Colorado County, where I built and maintained the county’s technology infrastructure from the ground up.

This site is where I post about technology, network administration, and whatever else is on my mind.
